_readme: Luke edits this file, nobody else. The bot re-reads it every run and places nothing if anything here is missing or invalid. Numbers marked PLACEHOLDER are paper-only starting values, not Luke's limits.
_filters: Rules the bot trades (paper), in priority order. pmSharp3h is the Nov 17 audit's best-supported rule set: Polymarket, sharp wallet, whale bet 10 min to 3 h before start, first alert per market only.
_shadowFilters: Paper-tracked separately with the same price rules but no stake limits, so their forward records can be compared. They never use up a pick or a limit for the real rules.
_unitUsd: Dollars per unit. Not needed for paper (everything is in units). Live mode refuses to start while this is null.

limits._placeholders: PLACEHOLDERS for paper, sized to the audit: about 83 bets a day, worst drawdown 51u, 'size so a 75-unit drawdown is survivable'. Day = Central time. Loss stop = drawdown from the high point of settled net results since lossStopResetAt.

checks._note: Limit price = whale's price + maxPriceRiseCents (audit: don't chase past +1¢). Above it the order rests until it fills or hits the cutoff. maxPriceDropCents null = take a better price than the whale's. A quote older than maxQuoteAgeMinutes is treated as no quote.

fees._note: Taker fee per contract = rate × P × (1 − P), charged win or lose. Paper charges it when an order fills on placement (crossing the spread). An order that rests and fills later is treated as a maker fill: no fee.

trialGates._note: Audit stop rules, shown on the tracker. Stop if, after clvBets bets, fills don't beat the close on average; or after roiBets bets net ROI is below minNetRoiPct; or the median fill is more than maxMedianSlipCents worse than the whale's.
